args.title: Persist selected export format in localStorage
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Update ExportButton to load and save the selected export format in localStorage so it remembers the user's choice across visits.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton currently initializes its format state from defaultFormat without persisting or recalling the user's previous selection from localStorage. We should update ExportButton to load and save the selected export format in localStorage so it remembers the user's choice across visits.
